motivation: Separate proof that K=2 alias state is correct from the system claim that a resident cache data plane removes large host-device transfers.

generation_identity.placement: post-gather full-tensor replica on every rank

actions.1: shift ring and store candidate anchor

graph.known_limitation: The static signature includes one full candidate input and one full tensor output even on PREDICT. H1a is not the final predictor+scheduler+latent-state data plane.

checks: device prediction matches the current FP32-accumulate then BF16-round host predictor

report: nrt_tensor_write/read count, bytes, and time from Neuron Profile inspect

decision.mechanism_pass: Only establishes alias state and numerical parity.
decision.architecture_pass: Requires zero full-tensor host write and zero full-tensor host read on a skipped step after predictor, scheduler update, and latent state are composed. H1a is expected to expose rather than satisfy this condition.
decision.next_if_large_transfer_observed: Implement H1b with predictor, scheduler update, and latent state inside one resident cache-step data plane; separately solve the backbone-to-state inter-NEFF handoff.
decision.stop_if_no_zero_copy_or_composable_bound: Do not call the design accelerator-resident; shrink the claim to host-controlled multi-graph runtime or redraw the graph boundary.
